export.operation: Inference-only intervention: zero columns9:21 of the learned measurement projection, corresponding to log2 WB and3x3 camera matrix. Retain CFA values/masks, physical photometry anchors and projection bias; physical WB/matrix processing and DINO rendering remain unchanged. Zero new training updates.
export.remaining: Full numerical/qualitative evaluation; no model promotion or quality claim yet.

known.protocol: Mean crops within each noisy capture, mean captures within scene, mean scenes. Bootstrap scenes, not crops.
known.reference: Primary: measured clean CFA samples after shared integer alignment/gain. Auxiliary RGB: calibrated LibRaw AHD.
caveats: Low-ISO references retain noise; AHD-derived RGB is not exact RGB ground truth.
Development scenes may be in RawNIND training. Test targets must stay out of model selection.

selection.notes: GFX100S / 55mm. Noisy DSCF3879: ISO6400, f/1.7, 1/240s, 17:13:27. Reference DSCF3880: ISO100, f/5.6, 3s, 17:17:05. Captured 3m38s apart with nearly identical framing. Aperture, depth of field, clouds, lights and moving subjects still differ. Native sensor crops with input/reference-only integer coordinate matching; no resizing or warping, no per-panel brightness adjustment. Qualitative reference, not exact ground truth; evaluation-only, never training.
